caption: The drawing features a single ornate door handle mounted on a decorative backplate. The handle and backplate are primarily rendered in varying shades of brown, suggesting a metal material with a patina. The backplate has an elaborate, symmetrical design with curving and rounded edges, some of which have small holes, likely for mounting. The handle itself is elongated, with three prominent rounded ring-like sections along its length for grip. There are hints of blue-green oxidation on different areas of both the handle and the backplate, especially near the top and bottom, indicating aging or weathering of the metal. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or decorations present. There is a small, handwritten inscription in red ink at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Suffolk Latch
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
